evals.prompt: diagram our order fulfilment process for the ops wiki and colour-code it by team. Sales: order received, fraud check (pass/fail), reject order. Warehouse: look up stock in the inventory DB, pick, pack, print label. Shipping: carrier pickup, send tracking, delivered? (yes/no). Support: retry delivery when it isn't delivered, close ticket when it is.
evals.expected_output: A top-down flowchart of about 12 nodes grouped into one subgraph per team, colored by team with complete classDefs, decisions as diamonds and the inventory DB as a cylinder.
assertions: Uses `flowchart TD` (or `TB`), not `LR`
Groups the nodes into subgraphs, e.g. one per team
Every `classDef` sets `fill`, `stroke`, and `color` together
Defines one class per team (Sales, Warehouse, Shipping, Support), each with a distinct fill
Every team-owned node is assigned its own team's class (via `class` or `:::`), and no node carries another team's class
No subgraph that declares `direction` has an edge between one of its inner nodes and a node outside it (cross-team edges join subgraphs at the boundary, or the `direction` lines are omitted)
The fraud check and delivered checks are diamonds `{...}` and the inventory DB is a cylinder `[(...)]`
Validates with `npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli` or states that it could not run and names the unverified syntax
